### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only symptoms, complaints, and relevant history explicitly stated by the patient. Do not include objective findings (e.g., physical exam, vital signs, lab results) or diagnostic assessments in this section.
[O-Section]: Include only objective findings from the physical exam, vital signs, and lab results as observed or stated by the doctor.
[P-Section]: List only explicit, actionable recommendations, treatments, referrals, or follow-up instructions stated by the doctor. Do not infer plan items from general conversational exchanges or patient-doctor interactions.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only symptoms, complaints, and relevant history explicitly stated by the patient, using their exact words or close paraphrasing. Do not include objective findings (e.g., physical exam, vital signs, lab results) or diagnostic assessments, and never use objective medical terminology to describe subjective patient complaints.
[O-Section]: Include only objective findings from the physical exam, vital signs, and lab results as observed or stated by the doctor.
[P-Section]: List only explicit, actionable recommendations, treatments, referrals, or follow-up instructions stated by the doctor. Do not infer plan items from general conversational exchanges or patient-doctor interactions.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: When reporting lab results, accurately reflect their status (e.g., 'previous', 'current', 'pending') as explicitly stated in the transcript; do not infer a status not supported by the conversation.
